mapper.select: SELECT payment_method_profile_id, payment_method_profile_code, payment_method_code, status FROM t_payment_method_profile WHERE payment_method_profile_code IN (SELECT payment_method_profile_code FROM t_commercial_term_price WHERE term_price_id IN (SELECT term_price_id FROM t_commercial_term_price WHERE term_version_id IN (SELECT term_version_id FROM t_commercial_term_version WHERE term_plan_id IN (SELECT term_plan_id FROM t_commercial_term_plan WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR local_partner_id IN #{partnerId})) AND 1 = 0entity_no IN #{entityNo})) ORDER BY payment_method_profile_id
